notes.en: Built around a bold gold silhouette with three graduated tiers of aged-ink engraving so the dual-pose figure simplifies cleanly down to the 38px navbar size while retaining Renaissance anatomical detail at 700px. Iterated across six rendered passes to eliminate longitudinal limb striping and joint cross-bars, tuck the spread feet and raised fingertips cleanly inside the circle-square intersections, and balance the parted hair crown over a solemn face. The foreshortened front feet and subtle finger tapers remain slightly stylized at full zoom so the extremities stay legible at small sizes.
